scope: Separate completed three-seed matched SWD utility attribution; preserves the earlier physical-attribution snapshot.
delta_definition: SWD10 minus SWD0; negative error differences favor SWD10. Relative changes are SWD10/SWD0 - 1.
statistics: Mean, sample SD and range across all three matched seeds; SD is not a confidence interval. No fitting, inference, array reads, CI averaging or seed selection.

source_report.role: Historical immutable physical-attribution source and checkpoint/map/training provenance binding ledger.

binding_policy: Read the six utility JSONs and hash/read their existing JSON config/summary/history/physical reports against the earlier attribution ledger. Checkpoint and calibration archive hashes are compared with that previously verified ledger; archives are not reopened or deserialized.

task.name: within_day_observed_history_next_interval_linear_ridge
task.macro_definition: Arithmetic mean of per-condition RMSE/MAE; each condition has equal weight.

source_training_pool.policy: Exact verified GAN gradient-training subset; also the resampling/copula profile-fitting source.

utility_training_selection.policy: All actual training rows, or uniform without replacement using seed+100 if capped.

validation_selection.policy: Uniform without replacement within every observed condition; matches cli.evaluate_checkpoint.

training_budget.balanced_sampler: 4 conditions x 128 samples, replacement within class, 1184 full batches per epoch.
training_budget.selected_checkpoint_qualification: Full completed-run exposure matches within each seed. Selected checkpoint epochs may differ under the same validation criterion; selected-prefix counts are recorded per run.

uncertainty.interpretation: No paired SWD0-versus-SWD10 utility uncertainty has been computed; descriptive consistency across three seeds is not a significance or noninferiority result.

limitations: Same development validation set and checkpoint-selection rule; unseen-test performance unknown.
This comparison isolates the SWD weight within the recorded balanced hinge-SN training package and its selection procedure, not every architecture/loss/normalization choice.
Calibration is fitted separately for each checkpoint using the same TRAIN-only rule; calibrated attribution is therefore the difference between complete train-and-calibrate procedures.
Only three matched seeds. The later five-seed SWD10 report is not an expanded five-seed weight attribution.
Both arms can lie inside the descriptive 10% real/resampling RMSE tolerance; passing it does not demonstrate that SWD is necessary or establish noninferiority.
Observed-history next-interval linear-ridge utility is one narrow task, not annual, day-ahead or broad application validation.
vector_encoding: Every two-value metric vector follows metric_order; per_condition_delta rows follow condition_order.
